sections.title: 1. Service Description
sections.body: This system helps support teams manage conversations, tickets, knowledge bases, reception configurations, and related operational data. You may access and use it only within your authorized business scope.

sections.title: 2. Accounts and Access
sections.body: You are responsible for protecting your account, password, tokens, and third-party sign-in credentials. Activity caused by shared, leaked, or misused credentials may be treated as activity by the account holder.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable Use
sections.body: You must not use the system for unlawful activity, rights infringement, service disruption, privilege bypassing, malicious code, unrelated data, or unauthorized sensitive information.

sections.title: 4. Data and Content Responsibility
sections.body: Content you create, upload, sync, or process in the system should be lawful, accurate, and aligned with internal management requirements. Necessary activity records may be retained for security, audit, operations, and compliance.

sections.title: 5. Service Changes and Availability
sections.body: System features may change due to product iteration, maintenance, security fixes, or third-party service changes. The service provider aims to keep the service stable but does not promise that any feature will remain unchanged or uninterrupted.

sections.title: 6. Disclaimer
sections.body: Generated content, automatic assignment, summaries, and suggestions are assistive only. Final business judgment, response content, and handling outcomes should be confirmed by authorized personnel.

sections.title: 7. Contact and Updates
sections.body: If you have questions about these terms, contact your system administrator or the service provider through published contact channels. The latest version displayed on this page applies after updates.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller and Contact
sections.body: The entity responsible for this release, its privacy contact, and the configured data-storage region are shown above. Enterprise customers may act as independent or joint controllers for their after-sales operations and must provide any notices required for their end users.

sections.title: 2. Information We Process
sections.body: We may process names, email addresses, phone numbers, accounts and sign-in records; devices, products, service codes and bindings; support conversations, messages, tickets, diagnoses, repairs and video sessions; photos, audio, video and attachments you choose to provide; IP addresses, device identifiers, push tokens, activity logs and crash diagnostics.

sections.title: 3. Camera, Microphone, Photos and Files
sections.body: The App requests camera, microphone or photo access only when you take a field photo, join video support, send voice content or select a file. This content is used for diagnosis, remote collaboration and service records. Denying a permission does not affect unrelated profile, device or ticket features.

sections.title: 4. Purposes and Legal Bases
sections.body: We use information to create and protect accounts, bind devices, provide AI-assisted and human support, create and track tickets, enable video collaboration, send service notices, prevent abuse, audit activity, perform contracts and meet legal obligations. Where consent is required, we ask before collection.

sections.title: 5. Service Providers
sections.body: Depending on tenant configuration, data may be processed by Jitsi video services, AI model and speech providers, object storage, email or SMS channels, Apple APNs and Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM). We send only data needed for the selected function. AI output supports diagnosis; authorized personnel make final service decisions.

sections.title: 6. Storage Region, Transfers and Security
sections.body: The configured storage region for this release appears above. Video, AI, push, or tenant-selected providers may process necessary data in other countries. Where data crosses borders, we apply measures required by applicable law and contract, including access controls, encrypted transport, least privilege and provider safeguards.

sections.title: 7. Retention
sections.body: Account profile data is retained until account deletion. Push tokens are revoked on sign-out, invalidation or deletion. Audit logs, notifications and consent records follow tenant policy and default to 365 days if not configured. Tickets, conversations and repair records are retained as required for service contracts, product safety and law, then deleted or de-identified.

sections.title: 8. Access, Correction and Deletion
sections.body: You can update your profile under My and delete the account under Account and Privacy by confirming the current password. Deletion removes profile data, device access, identities, permissions, sessions and push tokens. Required ticket and repair records are de-identified. If you cannot sign in, use the privacy contact above.

sections.title: 9. Local Storage, Complaints and Updates
sections.body: The App uses local storage for session state, language and necessary preferences. You may use the privacy email above to request access, correction, deletion or restriction, or to complain, and may contact your local authority. We update the date and request renewed consent where material changes require it.
